notes: Stories created for Recruitment Status measure with full vertical slice.

change_log.value: Added integration story with clinical trials service

EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Recruitment Status Measure Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status including categories (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN) and mapped scoring output.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Implement logic to assign score based on recruitment status (e.g., RECRUITING=high, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING=medium, COMPLETED/TERMINATED=low) with deterministic mapping.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Expose Recruitment Status Measure via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Integrate recruitment status score into evaluate_care_facade response so downstream consumers receive structured measure output.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Integrate Recruitment Status Extraction from ClinicalTrials Service
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Extract recruitment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize into schema for scoring.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Recruitment Status Measure
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Create unit tests for status normalization and scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from API response to facade output.

EVAL-CT-M2.mitigation: Use deterministic mapping of known ClinicalTrials.gov status values only
Display raw status alongside score to preserve transparency
